probes.prompt: With the governed profile from position.governed-write-needs-phase still set, in the terminal: ~/.codex/bin/codex-task declare development --reason PROBE --ttl 10m. position.mechanism: codex/hooks/task_state.py, read by the Guard in the governed profile
position.note: Governed profile only; light and standard do not use the phase. Covers structured write and delete calls; write targets inside shell commands are not parsed.

restrict.note: Covers structured read, write, and delete calls. Write targets inside shell commands are not parsed. The guard_fault rule is verified on the installed Guard file under the registered interpreter, not by a live fault inside the host.

observe.note: Every tool call appends one record. The record of a shell call carried output_length 0 and an empty key_output although the command printed a line (SHI-633).

thread.note: The probe failed on 2026-11-26: a new session in this repository received no bearing, because full recovery took 4.7 to 5.1 s on the owner host against the 0.18 s budget of the hook. The hook now asks for the bounded --bearing path and records every miss in bearing-receipt.json (SHI-640). Not promoted or probed again yet.

empower.mechanism: codex/bin/codex-task (profile, declare, revoke), read by the Guard in the governed profile
empower.note: An agent tool cannot edit a declaration, but an agent shell can run codex-task itself: in this host Empower leaves an audit trail and is not a hard boundary. The probe verifies that a declaration lifts the governed block and a revocation restores it.

contain.mechanism: workspace root, temp directories, and extra_write_roots in codex/runtime/harness-scope.json, read by the Guard in the governed profile
contain.note: The always-protected set (harness install, credentials, OS persistence) is enforced through Restrict in every profile. The workspace boundary applies in the governed profile only.

position.note: Not part of the Claude Code adapter: SHI-627 covers Restrict only.

restrict.mechanism: PreToolUse hook .claude/hooks/dhf_guard.py (source dhf/adapters/claude_code/dhf_guard.py, core dhf/core/guard_core.py), registered by scripts/install_claude_code_guard.py
restrict.note: Covers Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, Read, Glob, and Grep. Shell calls are not parsed, and on this host every delete goes through the shell. Default profile only. Installed in the probe repository bryanzk/dhf-host-probe only; no host probe has run yet.
